card.name: Words just before 'devolved' or 'passed'
card.fires_on: Words in history or law passages where power, rights or duties are about to be handed over or transferred, such as 'devolved', 'fell to', 'pass to', 'transferred'. It fires on the word just before that verb or on the start of it.

modes.label: Start of devolve
modes.description: The first piece of the word 'devolved' in a passage about government power.
modes.example: the imperial government<< dev>>olved into a series of shogun

modes.label: Before a transfer verb
modes.description: A subject or helper word just before a verb of passing, falling to, or transferring authority or property.
modes.example: the ownership would not pass to the surviving party but<< would>> pass under their Will into their Estate.

modes.label: Subject of transfer
modes.description: A noun for power, duty or title that is about to be handed on.
modes.example: most of their<< functions>> transferred to the popularly-elected City Commissioners

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words starting with 'dev', as in 'devolve'.
card.plain: It lights up where power, property or duties are about to be handed over to someone else, as in 'devolved'.
